description.en: Plays the preview of the next chapter: a slideshow of pictures with narration. It closes the BGM, fades both screens out, loads the background data/img/np_bg_<LG>.xi, the first picture npNN_1 and the narration npNN_<LG> (NN = _evt_id), fades in and plays the narration. The pictures npNN_2 to npNN_<_img_num> then fade in one after the other, spread over about 18 seconds (1080 frames in total). At the end it fades out, deletes the pictures and closes the sound.
Preview number NN (two digits in the file names).

examples.case: At the end of chapter 2 (real usage, from ev42015100.nut)
